title: Update Motor Speeds
instructions:
Complete the function `setMotorSpeed`. It receives a `DoubleArray` of 4 motor speeds and an `index` (which motor to change) and a `newSpeed` value.

Set the motor at the given index to the new speed, then print every motor speed on its own line.
hint: Use `speeds[index] = newSpeed` to change the value. Then use a for loop over `speeds` to print each one.
